source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Keeping the client positioned flat on their back throughout the entire seizure and the recovery period that follows","B":"Turning the client to the side, if possible, both during and after the seizure to help protect the airway from secretions or vomitus","C":"Fairly few specific positioning considerations actually being relevant during a client's seizure episode","D":"Elevating the head of the bed to a fully upright position throughout the duration of the seizure itself"}}
source_row.rationale: Appropriate seizure positioning includes turning the client to the side, if possible, both during and after the seizure to help protect the airway from secretions or vomitus, an important safety measure given the risk of aspiration during and immediately following seizure activity.
source_row.source_name: Epilepsy Foundation — Seizure Positioning for Airway Safety
